title: Token Usage cache first

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When cached aggregate data covers the requested Token Usage period, CodexPill must present it before starting scanner work and must not restart scanning for repeated menu/runtime refreshes.
When refreshing a cached selected period, CodexPill must reuse unchanged synthetic file contributions and rescan only new or changed eligible files.

targetSurface: CodexPill Token Usage cache/runtime fixture boundary

nonClaims: Does not prove Token Usage UI rendering.
Does not prove diagnostics export privacy.
Does not prove saved-account, workspace, organization, or remote-host usage history.
Does not prove real local Codex history scanning.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
